goals: Verify that CharManager.countUniqueChars correctly implements its caching strategy, ensuring cached results are returned on a cache hit and new results are calculated and cached on a cache miss.
Verify that CharManager.countUniqueChars correctly handles an empty input string.
activities: Initialize Mockito mocks for test class fields.
Initialize the manager field and inject mocks into it.
Create a new CharManager instance, replacing the @InjectMocks instance.
Set the mocked CharCalculator (field) on the manager.
Set the mocked CharCounter (field) on the manager.
Define an input string 'Hello, World!'.
Define an expected result string.
Configure the cache mock to return the expected result when 'get' is called with the input string.
Call the 'countUniqueChars' method on the manager with the input string.
Verify that the 'countUniqueChars' method of the calculator mock was never called.
Assert that the returned result matches the expected string.
